pin.longFormSummary:
Toy Story character theming, oversized courtyard figures and immersive rooms create a family base for Shanghai Disneyland; room themes and prices vary.

Family stay

The 800-room hotel opened on 16 June 2016. Woody and Buzz Lightyear inspire its wings and courtyards, while room choices include more deeply themed options. Choose the exact room theme and confirm occupancy when booking; a Buzz Lightyear room photo does not represent every room category.

Resort transport connects the hotel and Shanghai Disneyland. The August 2026 Mouse Hacking review also describes a signed walking route taking its family just under 20 minutes; walking times depend on pace and route. Check current transport arrangements and park admission conditions.

Budget and booking

This is a family selection. The same firsthand review describes premium pricing for its specially themed room, so compare your actual dates and room categories rather than assuming the Toy Story name means a low room rate. Park tickets and meals are separate unless explicitly included in the booked package.

hotel.basis: Opened 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor property snapshot with 375 reviews; Rooms/Service/Location/Cleanliness/Value 4.6/4.7/4.6/4.6/4.3 of 5, rounded to half points. Snapshot totals and scores may lag the live site; Toy Story’s opened snapshot is an older 2025 page. MICHELIN destination listings and property-name searches, and Forbes Travel Guide destination directories, did not verify a current property-specific distinction; listings are paginated, so absence is not proof of no award. AAA coverage does not include France or China. Acclaim is unknown, not zero.

pin.longFormSummary:
A compact design hotel beside Gare de Lyon, with an XL bed, shared lounge spaces and easy access to Paris by rail and metro.

Opening milestone

This pin dates the hotel’s grand-opening celebration on 22 September 2017, described by Bonjour Paris four days later. The celebration is distinct from the earlier guest opening.

Value and room tradeoffs

Bonjour Paris places the hotel among the city’s more affordable design stays, with 338 rooms and shared living spaces in a converted office tower. Rooms trade floor space for a large bed and access to common areas. This is a practical base near Gare de Lyon rather than a traditional spacious Parisian room; compare the room layout and occupancy before booking.

The 12th-arrondissement location is well connected by train and metro, but allow transit time to sights such as the Louvre and Eiffel Tower. The 2017 review’s room-price example is historical and is not a current quote. Compare your dates, breakfast, taxes and cancellation terms.
